correctness.rationale: For every stated finite signed network, direct projector decomposition gives spectrum {0,N,lambda_j} with lambda_j>0, and exact powers. The off-diagonal generator entries imply an if-and-only-if Markov region via the Metzler criterion, with strict positivity at every positive time by Jensen. The within-block scalar kernel has a single positive root above the boundary because its exponential-weighted form is strictly convex with negative initial slope. The mass-one/signed-row argument gives exact endpoint norms. Taylor expansion in epsilon gives the linear root and quadratic amplitude coefficients; a limiting negative crossing function proves the gap-closing constant. The included checker passed 2941 finite regression assertions; this cannot substitute for the proofs.

value.rationale: Positive semidefinite signed Laplacians can support asymptotic consensus without being Markov generators. A nonlocal fractional spectral power restores a genuine conservative positive semigroup exactly below a sharp conductance- and block-size-dependent exponent; this is a nontrivial structural Markovization criterion. For all supercritical powers, the theorem gives exact time sets for positivity, worst-case endpoint norm and sharp linear/quadratic onset, while the spectral-gap closing law quantifies slowing as signed instability approaches. These are complete motivated invariants for a natural multi-block antagonistic network family, not merely a finite numerical improvement.
